PC: Resident asks nurse to explain why s/he has made the assessment of infection of the PICC line.
Resident asks what is being administered through the PICC line. [SP should answer “the antibiotics and IV fluids.”]
Resident asks if there is any other IV access.
Resident requests patient’s vital signs. [Must ask for ALL three for credit: temperature, blood pressure, heart rate.]
Resident told me to start a peripheral IV first.
Resident told me to discontinue (pull) the PICC after the peripheral IV is started.
Resident told me to culture the tip of the PICC.
Resident ordered a peripheral blood culture.
Resident said he/she will come to visit the patient.
ICS: Resident identifies service/specialty. For example, “Night Team,” “Cross Cover,” “Medicine [specific team name],” “ Surgery team,” “Pediatrics”
Resident gave an estimated time of arrival to see patient.
